valores.label: Commission members (a chairperson and two from each judicial district)

nota: Texto da cópia local de 23/09; vigência conferida no navegador do app em 26/09.
narracao: The law calls for a nine-member commission to tally the costs, including social, economic and environmental ones. The stated purpose is the people's "right to know."

conferencia.prova: "…a commission composed of nine members, including a chairperson and two persons from each judicial district, appointed by the governor and confirmed by the legislature…"
"…the social, economic, and environmental costs to the present and relocation sites…"
"The purpose of AS 44.06.050 – 44.06.060 is to guarantee to the people their right to know and to approve in advance all costs of relocating the capital or the legislature…"

fontes.documento: AS 44.06.010–.060 e a nota de revogação de AS 44.06.100–.299

leitura_hoje.nota: NÃO tocado hoje: o akleg.gov respondeu 403 a robô no dossiê, e site que recusa não se contorna. O texto vigente foi conferido no navegador do app, com o Lucas vendo, em 26/09/2026 (roteiros/juneau/volateis-conferidos.md); o texto aqui citado é o da cópia local de 23/09.
